The '''red crystal chair''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was found in [[Rhuidean]].

==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' is a chair, undecorated but made completely of red crystal.{{ref/book|5|23}}

==Use==
The use of the ''ter'angreal'' is unknown.
